svg.title: Workspace: lanes → panels → cards
svg.desc: Three columns: the left lane holds shelf, favourites, history, downloads and insight cards; the centre is the reader lane, which can take the whole usable width; the right lane holds discovery, file manager, page list, plugins, control and info panels. Notes explain lane input targeting.

svg.text: Lanes collapse and reorder; the centre one can take the whole usable width.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: Whichever lane the pointer is in owns the keys — input belongs to it immediately.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: Every card picks its own size class, so narrow and full-width slots both fit.
